definitions.explanation: Coming after all others in time or order.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}まで{食|た}べてください。
{最後|さいご}に{何|なに}か{質問|しつもん}がありますか。
examples.english: Do you have any questions at the end?

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{最後|さいご}で{泣|な}いた。
examples.english: I cried at the end of the movie.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}の{最後|さいご}の{問題|もんだい}が{一番|いちばん}{難|むずか}しかった。
examples.english: The last question on the exam was the most difficult.

examples.japanese: {最後|さいご}まで{諦|あきら}めないで{頑張|がんば}ったから、{良|よ}い{結果|けっか}が{出|で}たと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think I got good results because I didn't give up and kept trying until the end.

notes:
{最後|さいご} means the last or final item in a sequence, or the end of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {最後|さいご}の〜: the last... ({最後|さいご}の{電車|でんしゃ} = last train)
- {最後|さいご}に: at the end, finally
- {最後|さいご}まで: until the end
- これが{最後|さいご}: this is the last (one)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {最後|さいご}まで{諦|あきら}めない: don't give up until the end
- {最後|さいご}の{最後|さいご}まで: until the very end

CONTRAST:
- {最後|さいご}: last, final ↔ {最初|さいしょ}: first, beginning
- {最後|さいご}: last ↔ {終|お}わり: end (the ending itself)

NOTE:
{最後|さいご} emphasizes position in sequence. For expressing something happening "for the last time," use {最後|さいご}に〜する.
